encoding_note: Original JSON objects are embedded as parsed data; original byte hashes and paths remain alongside them. No measured sample is replaced by later qualification, smoke or follow-up runs.
statistic_note: Report percentages use 100 * (candidate process median / baseline process median - 1). Paired-round statistics are separate. The parameter campaign retains its original paired-median headline fields; do not interpret them as ratios of raw medians.

protocol.summary: Median of process ns/call samples; within-round comparison uses the means of the two baseline and two candidate samples.
protocol.extend_if: Every normal case on both runtimes improves median ns/call by at least 2% and improves in at least two of the three paired rounds. Exception case is diagnostic and excluded from this rule.
protocol.limits: Helper microbenchmark only; no whole-application speedup claim. Full traversal remains unchanged.
protocol.gc: Collected outside each measured loop, disabled inside the loop.

baseline.source_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256(sorted src/... path + NUL + bytes + NUL)

candidate.source_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256(sorted src/... path + NUL + bytes + NUL)

methodology.order: serial ABBA, five rounds per PHP runtime, no concurrent children
methodology.source_loading: Exact baseline git archive and candidate copy differing only in ParameterTarget; same vendor autoloader; ParameterTarget and TypeHints reflection file origins asserted before every sample.
methodology.case_selection: One already-loaded attribute per declaration. has exact/inherited/miss and first exact/inherited/miss. No autoload callbacks in timed loops; first includes native newInstance allocation for successful lookups.
methodology.settings: -n -d opcache.enable_cli=0; JIT disabled by CLI OPcache setting
methodology.timing: hrtime of a direct public helper loop, with a scalar checksum; startup, source loading and warmup excluded.
methodology.aggregation: Five paired differences between mean(A1,A2) and mean(B1,B2); medians of 10 raw samples per variant reported separately.
methodology.limits: Microbenchmark of helper calls, not an application latency prediction or a universal threshold. Shared-host noise remains possible.

data.source_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted repo-relative src/... UTF-8 path + NUL + exact bytes + NUL for all PHP source files.

timed_body.algorithm: Concatenate marked section label + NUL + exact body bytes + NUL in file encounter order.

protocol.aggregation: Median of process samples per variant, ratio of those medians; each paired round compares its two baseline and two candidate means.
protocol.timed_region: Only the fixed loop calling the public operation and assigning its last result; setup, verification, metadata warmup and explicit GC are excluded.
protocol.fiber: One Fiber executes a complete warmed measurement; creating and starting the Fiber are outside its inner timer.
protocol.build: Fresh containers inside an already running and warmed PHP process; not process cold start or application startup.
protocol.gc: Collected before and disabled during each measured loop.
protocol.controls: Warm shared get is unchanged by the proposed optimizations. Results are local workload measurements, not application latency promises.

protocol.aggregation: Median of process samples per variant, ratio of those medians; each paired round compares its two baseline and two candidate means.
protocol.timed_region: Only the fixed loop calling the public operation and assigning its last result; setup, verification, metadata warmup and explicit GC are excluded.
protocol.build: Fresh containers in batches of 100 inside a warmed process; sum batch elapsed_ns / total builds. This preserves the original 100-build retained-graph accumulation. Each batch uses the unchanged measure() and excludes its warmup, GC and verification. Not process or application startup.
protocol.gc: Collected before and disabled during each measured loop, separately for every 100-build batch. All 20 raw build batches are retained at the default 2000 total builds.
protocol.controls: Warm shared get is unchanged by the proposed optimizations. Results are local workload measurements, not application latency promises.
